title: Unstable SMP Death Plugin
description: If Your within 250block to a player you can see him in tab chat join/left death | KEY WORDS: | Proximity Chat | Spatial Audio | Kill Feed Filtering | Local Fatality Feed | Proximity Death Log | Area Neutralization | Unstable SMP Death  | Unstable SMP Death
body:
# Core Features
## Localized Communication:
### Death Alerts: 
You will only receive death notifications for players who perish within your immediate area. If a battle happens across the map, your chat remains clean; if it happens over the next hill, you'll know, So now you have to check tab every hr to clear no one is close to you
### Connection Notifications: 
Join and Leave messages are filtered based on proximity. You are only notified when a player enters or exits the server if their last known (or spawning) location is within your awareness zone.
